rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, lr=0.01, epochs=6, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 feasibility (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol) for wu_2015_trainable = end-to-end TRAINABLE Wu 2015 reconstruction (solver_wu_2015_trainable.py). GOAL: does Wu-trainable run on Mayo under the corrected path (staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample model.proj/model.dense_proj swap, bg_target=truth) and produce a FINITE val_score + comparison.png within the HARD 20-min train+score budget, scoring ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override)? ARCHITECTURE NOTE: this solver trains ONLY a handful of nn.Parameter scalars (per-band log-scale x4, sigmoid slope+offset x2, per-outer soft-threshold + residual-blend) wrapped around a band-weighted aliasing-free FBP + a soft-thresholded dense-residual pass; with wu_n_outer=1 that is 4+2+1+1 = 8 trainable scalars (n_bands=4). All scalars are HARD-CLAMPED inside the solver (band_scale 0.1-3.0, blend -0.5-2.0, soft_thresh 1e-5-0.05) so the optimizer cannot run away. CONFIG: wu_n_outer=1 (the discarded boundary-slice run flagged n_outer=1 as mandatory -- behavior hint only; it also HALVES the costly 2x-dense-projector residual pass per sample, the dominant per-slice cost), wu_n_bands=4 (default), lr=1e-2 (solver default; aggressive lr is fine for ~8 scalars and converges fast), epochs=6 (8 clamped scalars settle in very few epochs at lr=1e-2 -- this is NOT a deep net that under-trains; the real risk here is the opposite structural FBP ceiling, not under-convergence), train_n=200 stratified across the 4 Wagner train patients ps-groups, val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices, batch_size=1 + val_chunk=1 FORCED by per-sample-ps (each train step + each val slice swaps model.proj AND model.dense_proj to its slice ps), grad_clip=1.0 (MANDATORY Mayo guard: the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise), lambda_neg=1.0, weight_decay=0.0 (defer to iter-2+; the discarded run hinted weight_decay tuning around its run-best iter-11, treat as loose behavior hint only), loss_base=mse, seed=42. BUDGET REASONING: the solver has NO in-code max_train_s wall hook (cannot add one -- must not edit the solver .py), so the budget is enforced by SIZING: with wu_n_outer=1 the per-sample cost is 1 band-weighted sparse-FBP (4-band backproject) + 1 forward_project + 1 dense-FBP + 1 back_project -- heavier than DD-UNet (iter-1 418s @ep8) but LIGHTER than the unrolled k=3 itnet_v3 (iter-1 738s @ep8) because there is no per-step unrolled DC loop; at only 6 epochs over 200 train slices the dominant cost is the 214-slice val pass at chunk=1 with the dense projector. This sizes train+score comfortably under the 20-min budget (30-min SLURM wall) with room for the figure. HYPOTHESIS: if I fit Wu-trainable at n_outer=1 / lr=1e-2 / ep=6 on 200 stratified Mayo train slices, I expect a finite val_ssim that lands in/near the LD-FBP baseline band (~0.84-0.89 SSIM, hr near 0), because Wu-trainable is a tuned-FBP family (band-reweighting + ONE soft-thresholded residual pass, NO image-domain CNN denoiser) and can only recover the small headroom that band weighting + a single residual correction buys over plain FBP -- it is structurally close to FBP, unlike the dual-domain U-Net families that landed hr~0.27. The discarded boundary-slice run hinted ~0.9135 SSIM at run-best iter-11 (loose behavior hint, NOT a validated number under the corrected 214-slice 321px-FOV metric). This onboarding iter establishes the corrected-metric Wu-trainable baseline that iter-2+ will improve by tuning ONE knob (epochs/weight_decay first, then band/sigmoid knobs).

SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) PRIOR: iter-1 = SSIM 0.8370 / hr 0.0508, 8 params (wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, ep6, lr0.01), elapsed 335s. iter-2 = SSIM 0.8390 / hr 0.0337, 8 params (SAME but ep18), elapsed 866.6s. iter-1->iter-2 (epochs 6->18) was FLAT: val_ssim +0.0020 (within the +-0.001 noise band the iter-2 falsifier set), and hr actually FELL 0.0508->0.0337. Per-epoch train cost = (866.6-335)/(18-6) = 44.3 s/ep at n_bands=4. SLURM log confirms training converged (loss=0.00000 by ep1; band_scale already saturating to clamp by ep18) -- epochs is INERT, the falsifier for under-training FIRED. (2) FAILURE MODE: few-param tuned-FBP ceiling. Wu-trainable is a band-reweighted aliasing-free FBP + ONE soft-thresholded dense residual pass with NO image-domain CNN denoiser; it sits hr~0.04 just above the LD-FBP floor and epochs cannot move it. The OPEN question iter-2's falsifier handed to iter-3: is hr capacity-limited (too few frequency bands to separate signal from noise) or is the whole FBP-family structurally ceilinged regardless of capacity? (3) ONE KNOB: CAPACITY via wu_n_bands 4->6 (+2 frequency bands in the band-weighted aliasing-free FBP, line 198 band-loop). This is the iter-2 falsifier's prescribed lever ('iter-3 must add capacity, wu_n_bands up'). I deliberately pick wu_n_bands over wu_n_outer because (a) n_bands enriches the FBP frequency partition -- the exact structurally-FBP part the ceiling hypothesis is about; (b) it is BUDGET-SAFE: the band-loop (FFT-filter + back_project) scales LINEARLY with n_bands while the heavy dense-projector residual pass stays a single fixed pass at n_outer=1, vs wu_n_outer++ which DOUBLES that dominant cost; (c) wu_n_outer=1 is the campaign 'mandatory' hint, leave it. NEW PARAM COUNT: wu_n_bands+2+2*wu_n_outer = 6+2+2*1 = 10 trainable scalars (was 8). epochs held at the iter-1 anchor 6 (NOT a second knob -- iter-2 PROVED ep6 vs ep18 is a non-difference, 0.837 vs 0.839; reverting to ep6 restores the proven-equivalent baseline epoch budget so the wider 6-band bank fits the HARD 20-min wall with margin, isolating n_bands as the sole meaningful change). All else identical to iter-1/2: lr0.01, bs=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214(ALL L277), grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, seed=42. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if iter-3 SSIM rises measurably above 0.839 (>+0.005 over the noise band) with hr>0.05, Wu-trainable was frequency-band-capacity-limited and more bands buy real headroom. FALSIFIER: if SSIM REGRESSES or stays FLAT (<=0.840, within noise of iter-1/2) at 6 bands, Wu-trainable is STRUCTURALLY FBP-ceilinged on Mayo regardless of capacity -- exactly matching the few-param-bilateral pattern THIS tick (dual_domain_bilateral_supervised img_n_bf 3->6: 0.9192->0.9057 REGRESSED; hammernik filters-up also regressed), i.e. capacity bumps DESTABILISE these few-param FBP-family denoisers rather than help. A regression would be the strong confirmation that the lever is the FBP family itself, not its band count. (5) HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score budget, sized via the ep6 anchor: worst-case (whole per-sample cost scaling with n_bands, which over-counts since the residual pass is fixed) ~1.5x the iter-1 per-epoch -> ~66 s/ep x 6 = ~396s train + ~120s for the 1.5x-wider 214-slice val pass ~= 520s, with the val FIGURE outside the budget and well under the 1800s SLURM kill. val = ALL 214 L277 slices (do NOT reduce); grad_clip=1.0; bs=1 + val_chunk=1 forced by per-sample-ps; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted; per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample model.proj/model.dense_proj swap; bg_target=truth; 321px detector-geometry FOV default (NO fov override). (6) no control return.

CONFIRMATION / TERMINAL-LEVER iter. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) PRIOR TRAJECTORY: iter-1 = SSIM 0.8370 / hr 0.0508, 8 params (wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, ep6, lr0.01), elapsed 335s -- this is the BEST config. iter-2 = SSIM 0.8390 / hr 0.0337, 8 params (SAME but ep18), elapsed 866.6s -- epochs INERT (val_ssim +0.0020 within noise, hr FELL); the under-training falsifier FIRED. iter-3 = SSIM 0.8273 / hr 0.0, 10 params (wu_n_bands 4->6, ep6), elapsed 358s -- frequency-band capacity++ REGRESSED below the iter-1/2 baseline; the iter-3 falsifier FIRED (capacity bumps DESTABILISE these few-param FBP-family denoisers, matching dd_bilateral img_n_bf 3->6 0.9192->0.9057 and hammernik filters-up that same tick). (2) FAILURE MODE: few-param tuned-FBP ceiling (~hr 0.05). Wu-trainable is a band-reweighted aliasing-free FBP + soft-thresholded dense-residual pass(es) with NO image-domain CNN denoiser; epochs are inert and frequency-band count++ destabilises -- it sits hr~0.04-0.05 just above the LD-FBP floor and neither lever has moved it up. (3) ONE KNOB: wu_n_outer 1->2 (the SINGLE untried capacity lever). I revert wu_n_bands 6->4 to RESTORE the iter-1 BEST config (NOT iter-3's regressed 6 bands), and change ONLY wu_n_outer. This adds a SECOND outer soft-thresholded dense-residual denoising pass (solver forward() loop `for it in range(self.n_outer)`, lines 214-237: each pass = forward_project residual -> feature-preserving interp -> dense FBP -> per-outer soft-threshold -> per-outer learnable blend). It is the LAST structural capacity Wu offers that is orthogonal to the already-falsified epochs/n_bands levers, and it adds image-domain residual-correction depth rather than FBP frequency partitioning. NEW PARAM COUNT: wu_n_bands+2+2*wu_n_outer = 4+2+2*2 = 10 trainable scalars (was 8 at iter-1; iter-3's 6-band/1-outer was also 10) -- the +2 over iter-1 are the per-outer log_soft_thresh + residual_blend for the new second pass. BUDGET JUSTIFICATION: campaign_state flagged wu_n_outer=1 as a 'mandatory' HINT precisely because the 2x-dense-projector residual pass is the DOMINANT per-slice cost and n_outer=2 DOUBLES it. This is the ONE modest n_outer test the budget allows: sized at the iter-1 ep6 anchor (335s at n_outer=1). The doubled residual pass roughly doubles per-sample train+val cost vs iter-1 -> worst-case ~2x335 = ~670s for the dense pass + the band-FBP (unchanged at 4 bands) -> well under the 1200s 20-min budget and the 1800s SLURM kill, with the val FIGURE outside the budget. ep6 is correct: iter-2 PROVED ep6==ep18 (0.837 vs 0.839), so ep6 isolates wu_n_outer as the sole meaningful change AND keeps the doubled-residual run inside the wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if a second outer residual-denoising pass buys real image-domain headroom, iter-4 hr rises measurably above the iter-1 best 0.0508 (SSIM > 0.842, >+0.005 over the noise band). FALSIFIER (terminal): if hr <= 0.051 (at/below the iter-1 best) OR SSIM REGRESSES/stays FLAT, then epochs (inert), frequency bands (regressed), AND outer residual depth (this iter) have ALL failed to lift hr -- Wu-trainable is STRUCTURALLY FBP-ceilinged on Mayo regardless of its capacity knobs. File that verdict: the few-param tuned-FBP family caps at hr~0.05 on real-helical Mayo, far below the dual-domain U-Net families (hr~0.27), because it lacks an image-domain learned denoiser. (5) HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score budget, sized via the ep6 anchor with the n_outer=2 doubling accounted for above; val = ALL 214 L277 slices (do NOT reduce); grad_clip=1.0 (MANDATORY Mayo guard -- the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise); bs=1 + val_chunk=1 forced by per-sample-ps; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted; per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample model.proj/model.dense_proj swap; bg_target=truth; 321px detector-geometry FOV default (NO fov override).
